problem: Handoff artifact/catalog and acceptance ledger were projected with separate component reads, allowing concurrent committed writes to mix histories.
correction: Wrap handoff-show and handoff-list projections in withProjectReadSnapshot; task/handoffs resource delegates to the same list projection. Prepared operations retain staged observations via existing snapshot helper policy.

tests.regressions: Independent writable connection updates a ledger row after envelope bytes are read; each show/list/public resource projection owns a readonly copy and retains OPEN from its committed snapshot while live bytes are changed.

limitations: Scoped read consistency does not finish every public path or sole writer authority
